descriptions.text: Protect your clear blocks; carry them anywhere! This caddy holds one of each block size. The removable insert separates and protects blocks when lid is closed. Blocks not included. * Opens flat * Built-in handle for easy carrying * Finger holes in insert make it easy to remove blocks

images.description: A gray plastic storage or organization case with multiple compartments of varying sizes. The case features a hinged design with handles on both ends and contains rectangular and square-shaped compartments for storing small items. The molded interior shows various sized slots, with the largest compartments on the left and smaller compartments on the right side.

descriptions.text: The best projects start with the best products. Start your projects with our high-quality cardstock, formulated especially for discerning crafters. The ultrasmooth surface is ideal for stamping, so you get clean, crisp images. And it’s dyed with pure color all the way through so there’s no white core. * 24 sheets * 8-1/2" x 11" * Crumb Cake * Acid free * Lignin free

images.description: A single sheet of cardstock or heavy cardboard in a warm, neutral tan or kraft beige color. The rectangular sheet is displayed on a light gray background with subtle shadowing on the right and bottom edges, suggesting depth and dimension.
